note.en: Finishing each site’s last stage counts; the project opens only once all three sites are finished.

notes.zh: 此异常不会自然生成（spawn_chance base 0）。银河生成时选中因内特贸易体先驱者（需“宇宙风暴”DLC）后，人类玩家在带有该标记、尚未用作先驱者星系的贫瘠/寒冷贫瘠行星上勘察时，on_survey_planet 的随机事件（权重25）可能触发隐藏事件cstorms.100生成本异常，并在30天后发送通用联络报告。
notes.en: Never spawns naturally (spawn_chance base 0). With the Inetian precursor in the galaxy (Cosmic Storms DLC), surveying a barren or cold barren planet in a system flagged for it can roll hidden event cstorms.100 (on_survey_planet random_events weight 25), which adds this anomaly for a player empire with no precursor intro and sends a generic contact report 30 days later.

notes.zh: “解析坐标”项目通过星系初始化器 weathermanipulators_home_system 生成三处考古遗址（坐标A/B/C），后续调查在同一故事的坐标遗址部分（已合并）。
notes.en: The coordinates project spawns the weathermanipulators_home_system initializer with dig sites Coordinates A/B/C; the continuation is in the Coordinates part of this same story (merged).

notes.zh: 三处“坐标”遗址（A 殖民星球、B 工业星球、C 荒芜星球）由星系初始化器 weathermanipulators_home_system 一次创建（common/solar_system_initializers/cosmic_storm_initializers.txt:31；该初始化器注明“由事件生成，不用于银河生成”）。前一步是本故事开头的古老风暴庇护所：项目“解读坐标”（INETIAN_PROJECTS_01）成功后，cstorms.135 在地图上标出这个星系。
notes.en: The three "Coordinates" sites (A colonised planet, B industrial planet, C barren planet) are created together by the system initializer weathermanipulators_home_system (common/solar_system_initializers/cosmic_storm_initializers.txt:31, which says it is spawned by event, not at galaxy generation). The preceding step is the opening of this story: after the ancient storm shelter (cstorms.130) project "Unscramble the Coordinates" (INETIAN_PROJECTS_01), cstorms.135 marks this system on the map.

notes.zh: 由神器行动 artifact_inetian_research 启用，要求已完成因内特先驱者（cstorms.193 设置 completed_inetian_traders_precursor）。
notes.en: Enabled by the artifact action artifact_inetian_research, which requires the finished Inetian precursor (cstorms.193 sets completed_inetian_traders_precursor).

scope.zh: 整条因内特贸易体故事：开场（cstorms.100–135）、坐标A/B/C遗址、机械项目、风暴成因与最后庇护所、因内特秘密研究（INETIAN_PROJECTS_04）。
scope.en: The whole Inetian Traders story: opening (cstorms.100-135), Coordinates A/B/C sites, machine project, storm origin and last shelter, and the Inetian secrets research (INETIAN_PROJECTS_04).

uncertain: When the system is spawned: the initializer comment says it is spawned by event; that event belongs to the earlier Inetian story (from cstorms.100), now the opening of this same story.
